scope: All 16 remaining >=60 original candidate_review_pool Source IDs; event identity and document-stage triage, explicitly not a native 0.1P promotion or final selection. Preexisting R17_DISC_001 is an unrelated previously approved strict-pass Source ID and not part of the 16.

interpretation.date_rule: Event occurrence/signing/announcement differs from article collection date; September and October windows must be independently determined per edition.
interpretation.source_rule: Official original documents, original reporting, index pages, and articles citing other outlets are separate tiers; a bounded triage receipt cannot convert lower-tier material into a primary proof.
interpretation.full_rule: Existing canonical Full card identity is read-only and is not a new promotion. Distinct later milestones remain potential follow-up candidates; the native gate decides value.
interpretation.many_to_many_rule: Three news sources can be one economic event, whereas one reported award total can include at least two distinct buyer agreements. Do not infer economic event counts from URL counts.
interpretation.evidence_effect: Supplemental scoped evidence or a documented unresolved gap, never a change to original score, source pool, strict_passed_spec or economic event cluster.

cases.original_document_owner: China FAW affiliate Zhongqi New Energy / Leapmotor
cases.bounded_finding: The Zhongqi New Energy–Leapmotor battery-technology agreement is already the September 17 FAW–Leapmotor event in locked Full. The separate Qixin Power investment letter of intent must not be absorbed into this R&D source ID.
cases.must_not_claim: An additional contract, deployed solid-state cell production, or a second new Full card from this repeat report.
cases.remaining_native_gate: Formal duplicate-to-existing-event identity and source-lineage receipt; source-specific 0.1P judgment.

cases.bounded_finding: Fortis and Inelso signed a €25.5m joint investment agreement for a planned Serbia 30MWp solar facility and co-located BESS; battery energy capacity is not documented in the announcement. Enkraft is the delivery/EPC platform. Construction permit was expected, not reported as already obtained.
cases.must_not_claim: BESS MWh, an operating project, an issued permit, or €25.5m already spent.
cases.remaining_native_gate: Contract enforceability, BESS inclusion, battery capacity proof, Stage B card value.

cases.bounded_finding: Rune disclosed a $40m Series A and the RELIC solar-sited modular AI data-center offering, with $53.5m total funding to date. Funding/product announcement is not proof of completed datacenter deployments.
cases.must_not_claim: Operating MW of completed AI centers, 100%-off-grid power at all sites, or contracted BESS capacity.
cases.remaining_native_gate: Whether the solar/data-center package supplies a material battery/ESS structural implication and meets verified evidence threshold.

cases.original_document_owner: Chris Griffith prospective fund management group; original Business Day interview
cases.bounded_finding: Former Gold Fields CEO and associates intend to seek a fund targeting approximately $1bn for African critical minerals; no first close, capital commitment or mining investment is established.
cases.must_not_claim: $1bn fund raised or deployed, signed battery-grade offtake, funded mine project.
cases.remaining_native_gate: Issuer/fund manager prospectus or first-close confirmation and battery mineral asset relevance.

cases.bounded_finding: Mercuria announced a $500m commitment to VaultCo in September. The US EXIM Project Vault previously had an up-to-$10bn financing approval in February; these are separate milestones and amounts.
cases.must_not_claim: $500m of delivered critical minerals or conversion of a $10bn loan approval into an executed $10bn disbursement.
cases.remaining_native_gate: Commitment terms, downstream mineral procurement, project stage and prior Full follow-up relationship.

cases.bounded_finding: Sector reporting describes cooperation memoranda with projected ~7GW generation, 12–18GWh storage and a headline 536亿元/approximately $8bn portfolio. Original signatory contract and project-specific financing cannot yet be confirmed.
cases.must_not_claim: 536亿元 binding contract, confirmed storage capacity, EPC backlog, commissioned cross-border grid or construction start.
cases.remaining_native_gate: Direct signer/govt MOU text, project boundaries, financing and contract status.

cases.original_document_owner: U.S. District Court Eastern District of Michigan, filed order Doc.324
cases.bounded_finding: The court denied the LG-side motion for $2.5m in attorneys' fees to HOP from a previously approved $150m class settlement fund. The final settlement approval was not undone by this ruling.
cases.must_not_claim: Court overturned the $150m LG/GM settlement or vetoed all individual Bolt compensation settlements.
cases.remaining_native_gate: Determine value to battery safety/litigation signal versus routine fee allocation and preserve court-case identity.

cases.bounded_finding: LG Chem and Volkswagen will collaborate on ABS, engineering plastics and recycled PCR auto parts materials, a vehicle-materials research MOU rather than a battery cathode material supply agreement.
cases.must_not_claim: Cathode supply, EV battery pack award, battery production R&D milestone, or signed high-volume sales.
cases.remaining_native_gate: Battery/ESS direct causal relevance and why structurally important if retained.

cases.original_document_owner: Korea Investment Private Equity; group corporate press original not located
cases.bounded_finding: Three Source IDs repeat one reported ₩1trn group proprietary-capital investment platform proposal, with AI infrastructure among possible targets. A historical SK Ulsan GPS deal is a separate prior completed transaction, not new funding under this platform.
cases.must_not_claim: Three separate ₩1trn investment commitments, a ₩3trn total, an ESS-specific allocation, or finalized transactions funded from the new proposed platform.
cases.remaining_native_gate: KIP/parent-company original funding vehicle disclosure and proof of battery/ESS exposure, one-to-three source link only.

cases.bounded_finding: A reported $10.15m seed round is dated October 8; the older August 4 Mana–Saft joint-development agreement is a separate technological event, not proof that the seed round occurred in August or September.
cases.must_not_claim: September funding event, commercial sodium-ion shipments, or duplicate creation from August JDA.
cases.remaining_native_gate: Confirm native edition period and financing release, retain as October follow-up only if window permits.

cases.original_document_owner: Sebang Lithium Battery / Hyundai Motor / LG Energy Solution; original Hankyung reporting
cases.bounded_finding: Reporting attributes more than ₩3trn in aggregate future battery-pack awards to two distinct buyer/product paths: Hyundai HEV packs and LGES ESS packs. A business association repeats the report as '전해졌습니다,' not independent contract proof.
cases.must_not_claim: One ₩3trn contract, independently confirmed signed total, exact buyer split or already booked revenue.
cases.remaining_native_gate: DART or buyer/issuer contract announcement, scope and value split; formal source ID may map to two event units.

cases.original_document_owner: CALB / Hefei local-authority announcements; company item not located
cases.bounded_finding: CALB Hefei Phase III commenced operations with 25GWh annual designed capacity for EV and energy-storage products. Designed capacity is not audited production or output; a neighboring R&D institute memorandum is a separate event.
cases.must_not_claim: 25GWh fully utilized shipments, new 25GWh purchase agreement, or an additional September R&D-institute event counted as this factory startup.
cases.remaining_native_gate: Direct CALB or municipal detail page and 25GWh design-vs-realized distinction; formal Full/Related novelty check.

cases.original_document_owner: Ulsan Metropolitan City / HS Hyosung Energy Solutions Korea
cases.bounded_finding: Ulsan city official list contains announcement for the September 14 signed ₩1.2trn investment MOU for silicon-anode production through 2030. Planned first stage ₩300bn/5000t by Q1 2028 is reported separately. The locked Full R15_07 covers a prior March 31 JV equity contribution, not the September MOU.
cases.must_not_claim: ₩1.2trn spent, factories already commissioned, a customer product validation, or this September MOU as a duplicate of March JV capitalization.
cases.remaining_native_gate: Direct municipality per-item article/PDF or issuer release, signed MOU text, project stage, source-to-Full relation.

cases.original_document_owner: China Energy Storage Alliance (CNESA), co-organizer of sodium battery industry forum
cases.bounded_finding: Nine named battery/cathode industry participants jointly signed a strategic sodium cathode supply agreement for a combined 300,000 tonnes/CNY6bn over three years. Other forum signings for hard-carbon capacity and cell purchases are distinct subevents; neither means each of 22 enterprises bought 300kt.
cases.must_not_claim: 300kt per signatory, fulfilled delivery/sales, twenty-two independent 300kt purchase contracts, or a state-backed legally guaranteed orderbook.
cases.remaining_native_gate: Check legal bindingness of strategic agreement, parties, effective delivery terms, source-original language, and Full card novelty.
